prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Access Saved Desktop Pets & Synced Data", "body": "Logging into your account ensures existing pets are restored instantly and your desktop preferences stay safe."}}

   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Initializing Desktop Pet Rendering Engine...", "body": "Setting up screen boundaries and overlay permissions so your pet displays smoothly.", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}

   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Companion Base & Personality Traits", "style": "playful"}]}}}

   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "centered", "replace": {"path_options": [{"role": "path_options", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Choose Instant Companion vs Custom Pet Creation", "style": "emphasis"}]}}}
4: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Customization Pre-Adoption Check Screen: Inserts a dedicated verification screen before certificate generation to inspect pet traits and rendering health.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_verification", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_verification": {"headline": "Reviewing Pet Generation Settings", "body": "Verifying trait rendering and asset integrity before certificate issuance.", "show_progress": true}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_controls_guide", "home_intro"], "new_pet_controls_guide": {"headline": "How to Interact with Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Use the system tray icon and desktop shortcuts to hide, move, or talk to your pet anytime.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Right-click tray icon to manage pet visibility, sound, and settings.", "style": "rounded"}]}}
6: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Recovery Verification Hint: Displays a clear sign-in hint informing returning users how to retrieve saved desktop pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Already have a pet? Sign in with your registered account to restore your pet automatically."}}
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Engine Load Status Display: Adds explicit step counter and status details for system tray overlay registration while the pet app launches.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Preparing System Tray & Desktop Overlay", "body": "Initializing background processes and desktop shortcuts for quick pet management.", "show_step_counter": true, "show_progress": true}}
8: [adoption, hint] Photo Generation Quality Guidance Hint: Adds a helpful hint on the photo upload screen outlining clear lighting and pose recommendations.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best pet rendering results, upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward."}}
9: [choose_path, copy] Instant Companion Path Expectation Copy: Clarifies time expectations and path differences on the choose_path screen.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Pick Your Desktop Pet Journey", "body": "Choose Instant Starter for immediate desktop pet setup (under 1 min) or Custom Pet Creation for tailored traits."}}

verdicts.reason: Sign-in copy update clearly reassures returning users without violating any rules.
Adding progress and status information to the waiting screen preserves its core function.
Redesigning friend selection retains the required job of choosing a pet.
Redesigning path selection retains options for both adopting and custom creation.
Adding a new pre-adoption verification screen inside onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps.
Adding a new controls guide screen before home intro is allowed and preserves all required steps.
Adding a helpful sign-in hint complies with all base rules.
Adding load status details to the waiting screen maintains its underlying purpose.
Adding photo guidance hints to photo upload complies with all base rules.
Updating choose_path copy to explain setup time expectations keeps both paths intact and fair.
